The UPS shall be of 1 KVA capacity, Line Interactive type with Pure Sine Wave output. 2. The UPS shall be suitable for operation on a single-phase AC input supply of 2 30V, 50 Hz. 3. The UPS shall be equipped with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) to prote ct connected equipment against voltage fluctuations. 4. The UPS shall provide a minimum backup time of 30 minutes at 50% of its rat ed load. The bidder shall submit an OEM datasheet or technical document confir ming the backup performance. 5. The UPS shall be supplied with suitable Sealed Maintenance Free (SMF) batte

ries of adequate capacity to achieve the stipulated backup time. All batteries, a ccessories, connectors and cables required for proper functioning shall be supplied along with the UPS. 6. The UPS shall have built-in protection against overload, short circuit, deep dis charge, overcharging and voltage fluctuations. 7. The UPS shall have LED/LCD indications for input supply, battery status, char ging status and load/overload conditions. 8. The UPS and all supplied batteries shall carry a comprehensive onsite OEM w arranty of 03 years from the date of successful installation and commissioning. The warranty shall cover all parts, including batteries, electronic components a nd accessories, without any additional cost to the purchaser. 9. During the warranty period, any defective component or battery shall be repa ired or replaced by the OEM/authorized service provider free of cost, including l abour and transportation charges. 10. The bidder shall submit the OEM Authorization Certificate, wherever applica ble, along with the bid. 11. The bidder shall submit the OEM technical datasheet/catalogue clearly indic ating the offered UPS specifications, battery capacity and backup performance. 12. The UPS shall be supplied in brand-new, unused condition along with all sta ndard accessories, user manual and warranty documents. 13. Installation, commissioning and demonstration of the UPS shall be carried o ut by the OEM/authorised service provider at the consignee's location without a ny additional cost. 14. The supplied UPS shall comply with applicable BIS standards and statutory r equirements, wherever applicable. 15. The purchaser reserves the right to inspect and verify the supplied UPS and its performance, including the stipulated backup time, before acceptance.
